title: Explicit factorization of the flat single tensorator
statement: For a coefficient category B as in [def-kun-derived-tensor], a scheme X, and sheaves A,C on its small etale site with A flat as in [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], write s for degree-zero cochain inclusion, H for the homotopy quotient, Qh for the derived localization, and e(A)=singleFunctorObjIsoQh(A). The hom of the prescribed flat single tensor isomorphism is (e(A).hom tensor e(C).hom);mu(H composed Qh)(s(A),s(C));(H composed Qh)(singleCochainTensorIso(A,C).hom);e(A tensor C).inv. The explicit cochain comparison is [lem-pur-etale-single-cochain-monoidal].

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat) and 06YU (definition-derived-tor and signed symmetry immediately following it); degree-zero specialization of the canonical tensor localization.

proof.text: Expand the source definition. Take hom components of the tensor and composite isomorphisms and use asIso_hom. Expand the composite-functor tensorator. Functoriality combines the two cochain comparison maps, giving the claimed composite. No extra flatness hypothesis is used.

proof_origin.place: Direct component expansion of the prescribed single tensorator and the composite-functor lax tensorator.

lean.statement:
theorem singleFunctorObjTensorIso_factorization
    (A C : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (hA : ObjectProperty.flat A) :
    let sg := HomologicalComplex.single (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ) 0
    let F := HomotopyCategory.quotient (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh
    (singleFunctorObjTensorIso A C hA).hom =
      ((singleFunctorObjIsoQh A).hom ⊗ₘ (singleFunctorObjIsoQh C).hom) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (sg.obj A) (sg.obj C) ≫
        F.map (singleCochainTensorIso A C).hom ≫ (singleFunctorObjIsoQh (A ⊗ C)).inv
